name: Offline Survival Project — Ultimate Operations Edition v7

phone_browser.strategy: delegate localhost URL to the operating system installed/default browser
phone_browser.interactive_target_phone_result: RUN ON TARGET PHONE — not fabricated by build environment

v7_major_additions: Knowledge Atlas with 220 distinct bilingual survival subjects plus index
about 65.6k English and 65.3k Greek subject words in the V7 Knowledge Compendium
single-file standalone reader embedding all 220 bilingual chapters with no runtime network dependency
installed/default phone browser launcher for Android/Termux instead of browser-engine selection
on-device bilingual phone-browser diagnostics with local-only report export
global hazard supplement covering tornado, hurricane, storm surge, flash flood, rip current, avalanche, dust storm, severe storm, vehicle, boating and signaling scenarios
expanded medical-recognition, fire, electrical, battery, solar, water, sanitation, food, shelter and navigation chapters
risk-derived reading queue and review tracking stored locally
collection-scoped full-text Library search with traversal rejection
sentence-level narrative duplicate detection in the curated database
dated authoritative source anchors for safety-sensitive V7 chapters
residual_security_notes: The app-shell CSP still permits unsafe-inline for legacy inline handlers/styles.
State and full exported backups are plaintext unless protected by device/filesystem encryption.
No built-in user authentication is provided; localhost is the intended default trust boundary.
Interactive phone-browser diagnostics must be run on the target phone to validate that phone/browser combination.
